presence_rationale: Dedicated First Nations Strategy 'Fuelling the Fire' (10-year Strategy launched 2025), MoneyMinded program, hardship support frameworks. Topic comprehensively covered.
specificity_rationale: First Nations Strategy launched with three priorities (financial inclusion, banking First Nations economy, cultural intelligence), Strategy Office led by Shelley Cable, Deloitte Access Economics commissioned to forecast First Nations economy, Jawun partnership (5 employees seconded, 1,200 hours), First Nations Foundation, MoneyBusiness program. NZ MoneyMinded extended via partnerships, 5 new Pacific partnerships (3 Fiji, 2 Timor Leste). MoneyTalks, Customer Financial Wellbeing case management. ASIC settlement around hardship handling shows accountability.
quantification_rationale: Reports SASB FN-CB-240a.4: 126,422 MoneyMinded participants (107,236 AU, 18,596 Asia/Pacific, 590 NZ); >1.1M cumulative since 2002. $22.9M procured from 51 First Nations businesses. >$150M lent through First Nations Guarantee. 13,931 hardship customers in Australia (vs 14,031 in 2024). 4 in 1,000 home loan and 2 in 1,000 small business in hardship. 68% of hardship customers paid out or up-to-date. ASIC penalty $40M for 488 hardship-handling failures. SASB 240a.1/.2/.3 (no-cost accounts, small business loans amounts) not in retrieved evidence.
